record.question: A tabulation of data concerning every patient discharged from the hospital is known as:
record.explanation: Answer D: All of the above. A tabulation of data about discharged patients is described in record-management texts as discharge analysis, discharge-service analysis, or analysis of hospital service; these labels overlap in this stem. Source/context note: The three labels overlap; item tests legacy terminology rather than distinct methods. Reference: https://iris.who.int/bitstream/handle/10665/208125/9290610050_rev_eng.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
